author: Arnav
problem: A cycling club ride is split into legs, each a (km, hours) pair. Return the average speed over the whole ride in km/h, rounded to one decimal place, or 0.0 if there are no legs.
bug_description: Averages the speeds of the legs instead of dividing total distance by total time, which is only the same when every leg takes equally long.

comments.accurate: Overall average speed of the ride in km/h
comments.wrong_behavior: Average of the speeds ridden on each leg, in km/h
comments.wrong_location: Speed formula verified; check whether an empty ride should really return 0.0
